name: Desk Terminal, Even Dock
tagline: Desk Terminal, Vera Card with Coming up and the Contents plate docked under the question and the tube, a big Send and tall composer on the phone, Ideas filters as one row of keys, and a lit track down the To do rows.
concept: Three rolled changes on r18-mut-1 and nothing else: Home's second row is now Coming up (under Vera) beside the Contents plate and status line (under the tube), so the left column no longer ends in a void; on a phone Send is a full key with its word and the composer is 7rem tall; Ideas' banks of keys are one compact row each (sliding under a fade on a phone); desktop row text is a step up (17 to 19px) with the amber was-due kept, and a fine lit rail with a branch to each tick runs down the To do rows.
companions: Unchanged from the parent: sage #86d9a6 lights the new To do track (the everyday lit colour, not the signature green), amber stays on the late words and rings, steel-cyan on links and latched keys.
